name: chimera-vocal-synth
description: the ultimate vocal synthesizer - sing, speak, beatbox, and more
readme: A physical-modeling voice synthesizer in the browser. Every sound comes from a simulated airway (lungs, vocal folds or syrinx, a branched vocal tract, lips, nose), not from samples. The engine is Rust, compiled to WebAssembly for an AudioWorklet; the same code runs natively for tests and the chimera CLI.
